# Vendored fonts

Self-hosted so the toolkit makes no request to a font CDN. Loaded by the
`@font-face` rules at the top of `shared/toolkit.css`.

| File | Family | Author | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `IBMPlexSans-var.woff2` | IBM Plex Sans (variable) | IBM | SIL Open Font License 1.1 — https://github.com/IBM/plex/blob/master/LICENSE.txt |
| `IBMPlexMono-400.woff2`, `IBMPlexMono-500.woff2` | IBM Plex Mono | IBM | SIL Open Font License 1.1 — https://github.com/IBM/plex/blob/master/LICENSE.txt |
| `Newsreader-var.woff2` | Newsreader (variable) | Production Type | SIL Open Font License 1.1 — https://github.com/productiontype/Newsreader/blob/master/OFL.txt |
| `MaterialIconsOutlined-400.woff2` | Material Icons Outlined | Google | Apache License 2.0 — https://github.com/google/material-design-icons/blob/master/LICENSE |

The OFL asks that its full text travel with the fonts: add `OFL.txt` from the
links above to this folder.
